entities.summary: Ville Heinola is a Finnish professional ice hockey defenceman for the Winnipeg Jets of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was ranked as one of the top international skaters eligible for the 2019 NHL entry draft. Heinola was drafted 20th overall by the Jets.
